description: Gemini Pre-Audit Integration: CAR_m3_p3 and CAR_m5_p5 computation from daily return panel.

daily_market_data_10k_events.csv.description: Daily return panel (NOT abnormal return panel). Contains firm_return and market_return per event-day.
daily_market_data_10k_events.csv.status: NOT YET IN REPO — must be copied from korea_uni source

event_study_estimation_diagnostics.csv.description: Market model parameters per event. Provides alpha and beta for AR computation.
event_study_estimation_diagnostics.csv.status: NOT YET IN REPO — must be copied from korea_uni source

join_key.note: event_id_estimate matches market-data-pipeline event_id (padded CIK). event_id in event_study uses unpadded CIK and does NOT match.

crosscheck.target: CAR_m1_p1 recomputed vs existing (from event study)
crosscheck.on_conditional_fail: outputs written; manifests flagged crosscheck_pass=false; script exits with code 3

exit_codes.1: script error (bad column names, parse failure, etc.)
exit_codes.2: missing required input files (daily_returns or estimation_diagnostics not present)
exit_codes.3: CONDITIONAL FAIL — outputs written but CAR_m1_p1 cross-check failed

next_steps_after_completion: Verify CAR_m3_p3 / CAR_m5_p5 row counts in manifest
If crosscheck_pass=false: diagnose return_definition (log vs simple) and re-run
Re-run run-humor-car-hypothesis-regressions.yml with extended CARs as robustness DVs
Update humor_car_regression_models_schema.json: set placeholder_dvs.CAR_m3_p3 / CAR_m5_p5 to 'available'
